## Specific task description

Task instruction: Click the small flat switch tan top with the right arm.

Task description: The target is the light-brown flat switch on the light-colored square panel slightly right of center in the image. Use the right arm to press its upper part and switch it fully into position.

Success criteria: The movable switch reaches near the end of its travel in the target direction and completes the toggle. Merely touching its surface or moving it through only a small part of its travel does not count.

## Execution tips

- Contact the upper part of the movable button, away from its left and right edges, to preserve leverage for pushing it to turn. Avoid pressing on the surrounding fixed panel.
- Consider narrowing the right gripper to press with a smaller fingertip contact area, avoiding simultaneous contact at both ends of the button. Apply small forces approximately normal to its surface and adjust contact as it rotates, reducing slippage or continued force after reaching the stop.
- Adjust the pose in the open area in front of the panel, leaving clearance for the fingers and wrist to avoid hitting the gray container behind it or tall brown cup at the rear right.
